 The Saint Joe's Hawks take on the USF Bulls in Annapolis, MD. Tip-off is set for 3 p.m. ET on CBS Sports Network.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement USF is favored by -7.5 points on the spread with a moneyline of -315. The total is set at 151.5 points.
 Here's my Saint Joe's vs. USF prediction and college basketball picks for November 11, 2026.
 Saint Joe's vs USF Prediction
 Pick: Saint Joe's +7.5 (Play to +6) 
 My Saint Joe's vs USF best bet is on the Hawks to cover the spread. Be sure to find the best lines by using our live NCAAB odds page and download the Action Network app for the latest picks and analysis.
 Saint Joe's vs USF Odds
 Saint Joe's vs USF spread: Saint Joe's +7.5 (-114), USF -7.5 (-106)
 Saint Joe's vs USF over/under: 151.5 (-115o / -105u)
 Saint Joe's vs USF moneyline: Saint Joe's +250, USF -315
 Saint Joe's vs USF College Basketball Preview
 Saint Joseph's has opened the season with back-to-back wins, including an overtime game in which the Hawks scored 67 points against Lafayette . They'll face a step up in class when they head to the Veterans Classic in Maryland to take on USF.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Saint Joseph's has a legitimate shot to contend for the Atlantic 10 Championship, with the likes of George Mason , but most experts see the Hawks with a ceiling of the NIT.
 Jaiden Glover-Toscano is the clear star player, but he's also aided by Austin Williford's return. Williford was an All-Rookie A-10 his freshman year and sat out his second season with the Hawks.
 This team will excel with its guard play, but to be a consistent threat, it needs to find a 3-point marksman. To open the season, the Hawks are a combined 11-for-48 from beyond the arc.
 The Bulls are coming off what most consider a surprise year, and Bryan Hodgson has left for the coaching pastures of Providence . They have split their first two games under first-year coach Chris Mack. The loss to DePaul doesn't bode well for confidence as this season rolls on.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But if there is a coach that can find success, it's Mack. He has 300 career wins and nine tournament appearances. He also led College of Charleston to two straight seasons of 20 wins.
 This Bulls' roster is primarily made up of portal transfers, and we might see some growing pains as a result. They have three transfers that are either seniors or grad transfers, which might help ease the process of this rebuild.
 The experience will surely play a factor as we move through the season, because the non-conference schedule for the Bulls is formidable. They have look-ahead games against George Mason, Saint Louis , Dayton and Alabama .
 This spread has come in at 7.5 in some of the earliest lines, but it's come down to 6.5.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement I think in most situations it would be hard to back Saint Joseph's. But in a neutral-site game, with a clear proximity advantage for the underdogs, I like the points.
 We should get a close game early, and I expect Saint Joe's to lean heavily on its guards to control things.
 Pick: Saint Joseph's +7.5 (Play to +6)
